deployments_detail.use: Generative AI tools deployed to support teams across the business for internal productivity (minimising mundane tasks), with a stated roadmap toward supervised AI agents under human oversight.
Cloud-based predictive maintenance using AI for edge-based solutions
AI for strategic maintenance planning and efficiency (NEXT intelligent solutions rebranded)
Acquired SentianAI (2023); AI/ML for mineral-processing optimisation delivering customer recommendations; "holistic AI system"

Weir Motion Metrics AI + machine-vision systems (ShovelMetrics, TruckMetrics, PortaMetrics) on shovels, loaders and trucks for missing-tooth/lip-shroud detection, boulder/foreign-object detection, payload measurement and rock fragmentation analysis, reducing crusher downtime and improving safety. [Weir Motion Metrics (proprietary AI/computer vision)]

SentianAI-derived AI algorithms for minerals-processing optimisation: continuously learning/adapting models that optimise plant performance, address declining ore grades and reduce energy/CO2, deployed into live mining operations. [SentianAI (acquired by Weir, 2023)]

NEXT Intelligent Solutions - Production package: AI-powered Intelligent Assistant plus reinforcement-learning process automation that adjusts set-points in real time (ore feed, machine drift, cost, targets) to maximise mineral-processing efficiency. [Weir NEXT (proprietary AI)]

NEXT Intelligent Solutions - Uptime package: AI predictive maintenance with wear detection giving remaining-useful-life in real time and failure prediction models, plus automated parameter adjustment (e.g. slurry-pump throat-bush gaps) to reduce wear. [Weir NEXT (proprietary AI)]

Synertrex IIoT platform: cloud-connected smart sensors and AI-backed soft sensors on Weir equipment delivering predictive analytics and performance/condition monitoring for mining customers. [Weir Synertrex]

XMPro digital-twin partnership integrated into the Synertrex ecosystem to deliver event intelligence, predictive analytics and real-time decision support for mining equipment. [XMPro (digital twin / agentic AI)]

Strategic collaboration with Viking Analytics to add AI/ML condition-monitoring and predictive-maintenance diagnostics to Weir's NEXT intelligent solutions for mineral-processing plants. [Viking Analytics]
AI-driven mineral processing optimization to boost performance, reduce downtime, and improve operational efficiency
AI-powered process optimization solution for mining operations (NEXT intelligent solutions)
AI-based technologies for mine-to-mill performance optimization, downtime reduction, and equipment life extension
Motion Metrics: AI and machine vision technology for mining productivity, safety, and sustainability [Motion Metrics]

Responsible-AI governance programme: AI compliance tools deployed and responsible-AI principles embedded, alongside defences against AI-powered cyber threats (voice cloning, deepfakes) flagged as an enterprise risk.
